findings.title: Plugin request completion logs no longer include trace IDs
findings.body: The previous logger middleware explicitly extracted `tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false)` and emitted it as the `traceID` log field. This was removed, while the new contextual logger middleware only adds endpoint, plugin, datasource, and user attributes; it does not add the trace ID. `Logger.FromContext` consumes those contextual log attributes but does not derive a trace ID from the tracing span. Consequently, completed plugin request logs cannot be correlated with their traces anymore. Add the trace ID to the contextual attributes or retain the explicit traceID field, and cover this with a logging middleware test.
